newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: OCE 1995/96 PRELIMINARY NET UP 56 PERCENT.
newsitem.headline: OCE 1995/96 PRELIMINARY NET UP 56 PERCENT.

text.p: Oce-van der Grinten NV said on Friday it expected net profit in the financial year to November 30, 1996, would total more than 169 million guilders, up 56 percent from the 108 million posted in the previous year.
The photocopier maker said it expected group sales to have risen by 43 percent to about 4.2 billion guilders.
Oce said its chairman Harry Pennings had said in a New Year's speech he expected sales and profits would show a further rise in the current financial year.
"1996 was a successful year for Oce in every respect," Pennings was quoted as saying.
He added Oce had marketed promising new products and had strenghtened its position by buying the printer division of Siemens Nixdorf in April 1996.
Of the 4.2 billion sales expected for 1995/96, some 25 percent will have orginated from the acquired printer division.
Excluding the effects of this takeover, turnover would have risen by 18 percent, of which about three percent was caused by favourable changes in currency rates.
The company expects net profit per share will be about nine guilders, up 36 percent from 6.64 guilders in 1994/95.
Oce will publish full 1995/96 figures on February 17.
